title: derris thyrsiflora var. wallichii
intro: Derris thyrsiflora var. wallichii, commonly known as the Indian sarpagandha, is a plant species in the legume family that is native to the Himalayan region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to help manage stress, anxiety, and sleep disorders due to its sedative and anxiolytic properties. The therapeutic actions of Indian sarpagandha include its ability to modulate the central nervous system and exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
